definitions.gloss: downward revision; downgrade; lowering of an estimate
definitions.explanation: The act of revising a figure, forecast, or assessment to a lower level. Frequently used in business and economic contexts for earnings forecasts, economic growth projections, and credit ratings.

examples.japanese: {業績|ぎょうせき}{予想|よそう}を{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}した。
examples.english: They revised their earnings forecast downward.

examples.japanese: GDP{成長率|せいちょうりつ}が{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}された。
examples.english: The GDP growth rate was revised downward.

examples.japanese: {大幅|おおはば}な{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}を{受|う}けて、{株価|かぶか}が{急落|きゅうらく}した。
examples.english: The stock price plunged following a major downward revision.

notes:
Very common in business news and financial reporting. Composed of {下方|かほう} (downward) + {修正|しゅうせい} (revision/correction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業績|ぎょうせき}の{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい} — downward revision of earnings
- {見通|みとお}しを{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}する — to revise an outlook downward
- {大幅|おおはば}な{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい} — a major downward revision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上方修正|じょうほうしゅうせい} — upward revision (the opposite)
- {修正|しゅうせい} — revision, correction (neutral)
- {引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ — reduction, lowering
